remarks: Set behind the gates of Marbella Country Club, 30342 Golf Club Drive is a beautifully updated residence centered on privacy, comfort and Southern California indoor-outdoor living. The home offers a versatile four-bedroom floor plan, a dedicated private office and a backyard with a pool and spa, creating a setting that works equally well for family life and entertaining. Inside, soaring ceilings, fireplaces and custom built-ins define the main living spaces, while the home's open flow connects formal and informal areas with ease.
